dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日は宜しくお願い致します。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming today. We will begin at the scheduled time.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。最初にご年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm your counselor. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 17女です。
dialogue.content: I'm 17, female.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。本日はどういったご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What brings you here today?

dialogue.origin: 大学受験に失敗して途方に暮れてます、
dialogue.content: I failed my university entrance exams, and I'm at a complete loss.

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね...今そういうお気持ちなんですね
dialogue.content: I see... so that's how you're feeling right now.

dialogue.origin: はい、、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 頑張ってこられましたね。途方に暮れてしまうのも無理はないと思います。
dialogue.content: You've worked so hard. It's completely understandable that you'd feel at a loss.

dialogue.origin: もう少しお話し聞かせてくださいね。受験されたのは１校でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a little more? Did you apply to just one university?

dialogue.origin: 何校か滑り止めで受けたはいましたが、第一志望のところに行きたかったので、、
dialogue.content: I applied to a few safety schools, but I really wanted to go to my first-choice university...

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ....そうなんですねそれは１番希望するところに行きたかったですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, of course... You wanted to go to your top choice, right?

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、昨日合格発表だったんですけど
dialogue.content: That's right. The results were announced yesterday.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 来週から学校に行くのも嫌です、周りの友達にどういった顔していいのか
dialogue.content: I don't even want to go to school next week. I don't know how I'm supposed to face my friends.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、お辛い気持ちの中、来てくださってありがとうございます。周りのお友達からどう思われるか、気になってしまう感じですか？
dialogue.content: I see. Thank you for coming despite how difficult this must be for you. Are you worried about what your friends might think of you?

dialogue.origin: とゆうより、気遣われるのが目に見えそうで嫌です。周りにわたしが目指している大学なども言ってたので。
dialogue.content: It's more than that; I hate that I can already picture them tiptoeing around me. I told everyone which university I was aiming for, you see.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、なるほど...周りに気を遣わせてしまう事が、気がかりなんですよね。
dialogue.content: Yes, I see... So you're concerned about making others feel like they have to walk on eggshells around you.

dialogue.origin: はい、。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: しかも同じく志望してた人が合格してる姿とか見たくないし、、
dialogue.content: Besides, I don't want to see the people who were applying to the same university and got in...

dialogue.origin: もちろんそうですよね、そういった感情が芽生えるのも無理はないですよ。こういった時も周囲の方への気配りをされていてお優しいんだなと感じました。
dialogue.content: Of course, that's completely understandable. It's only natural to feel that way. It strikes me that even at a time like this, you're still so considerate of those around you. You seem very kind.

dialogue.origin: 合格発表があった時、どんなことを１番考えましたか？
dialogue.content: When the results were announced, what was the first thing that went through your mind?

dialogue.origin: 全然優しくはないと思います、
dialogue.content: I don't think I'm kind at all.

dialogue.origin: いままでやってきた努力は無駄だったんだな、って思いました
dialogue.content: I thought to myself, "All the effort I've put in up until now was for nothing."

dialogue.origin: ご自身では優しくはないと思うんですね、どうしてそう思うのですか？
dialogue.content: You don't see yourself as kind. Why do you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: そう思ったんですね、それだけたくさんの努力を重ねてこられたんですよね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what you thought. It just goes to show how much effort you've put in all this time.

dialogue.origin: 周りの人に気遣わせて申し訳ないな、とゆうよりそのような空気を感じるのが怖いんです。
dialogue.content: It's less that I feel sorry for making them be considerate, and more that I'm just scared of that kind of atmosphere.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、この1年間それに向けて勉強してきました
dialogue.content: That's right. I've been studying toward that for this whole past year.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、周りから感じる、気を遣われているなという空気感が嫌なのかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it may be that atmosphere you get from others, that sense that they're walking on eggshells around you, that you dislike.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、会いたくもないです
dialogue.content: That's right. I don't even want to see them.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そういった意味でも苦しいですよねあなたが１年間勉強をたくさん頑張られてきたのが伝わってきました。その中で、受験のことで途方に暮れてしまう気持ちと、周囲の空気感と、今はどちらがお辛く感じますか？もしくは、そのほかにもありますか？
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be painful in that sense, too. I can really tell how hard you've worked studying this past year. Between the feeling of being at a loss about the exam and the atmosphere with those around you, which feels more difficult for you right now? Or is there something else?

dialogue.origin: とりあえず今は何も考えられない状態ですね、何も考えたくないというか、
dialogue.content: Right now, I just can't think about anything. Or rather, I don't want to think about anything.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...昨日発表があったばかりですから、考えるのも嫌になってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: That makes sense... The results were just announced yesterday, so it's completely understandable that you wouldn't even want to think about it.

dialogue.origin: はい、両親にも今日不合格だったこと伝えようと思ってるのですが
dialogue.content: Yes, and I'm planning to tell my parents today that I didn't pass.

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ
dialogue.content: Yes, go on.

dialogue.origin: 悲しそうな顔見たくないですね
dialogue.content: I don't want to see the sad look on their faces.

dialogue.origin: ええ、そう思われるんですね、悲しませるかもしれないと不安になってしまいますよね。ご両親は受験のことであなたのことをサポートしてくれていたんですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I can understand that. It's natural to worry that you might make them sad. Were your parents supportive of you during your exam preparations?

dialogue.origin: はい、とても応援してくれてました
dialogue.content: Yes, they were very supportive.

dialogue.origin: お金を払ってもらって高い塾にも行ってたし
dialogue.content: They even paid for me to go to an expensive cram school.

dialogue.origin: 申し訳ないです
dialogue.content: I feel so guilty.

dialogue.origin: そうかそうか...あなたのこと近くで応援してくれていたんですね。素晴らしいご両親ですね。だからこそ、申し訳なく思ってしまうんですよね。
dialogue.content: I see... They were right there cheering you on. They sound like wonderful parents. And that's exactly why you feel so guilty, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: あなたはきっと、自分も苦しいけれど家族が悲しむのもしんどいんですよね...それだけ周りのことを考えていらっしゃるんですよね。
dialogue.content: You're hurting, of course, but it's also painful for you to see your family sad... It just shows how much you think about the people around you.

dialogue.origin: あなたはどうしてご両親がお金の面だったり精神的な面でも、あなたを応援してくれていたと思いますか？
dialogue.content: Why do you think your parents supported you, both financially and emotionally?

dialogue.origin: 家族ですからね、
dialogue.content: Because we're family.

dialogue.origin: 私のことを第一に考えてくれる両親なので、応援してくれてたと思います
dialogue.content: They're the kind of parents who always put me first, so I think that's why they were so supportive.

dialogue.origin: ええ、家族は応援したり、支えてくれる存在ですよね普段からご両親はあなたのことを気にかけてくれてるとお感じになっているんですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, family is there to support and encourage you. It sounds like you always feel that your parents are looking out for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どういった事でそうお感じになったんですか？
dialogue.content: What are some of the things that have made you feel that way?

dialogue.origin: 先ほども言いましたが、塾とかいかせてもらったり、あとは自分の夢をいつもそばで応援してくれてましたね、
dialogue.content: Like I said before, they sent me to cram school, and they've always been by my side, cheering on my dreams.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、そうでしたね。あなたもそんなご両親から受けている愛情をしっかり感じ取れる心の持ち主なんですよね。
dialogue.content: Mm-hm, that’s right. And you have the kind of heart that can truly feel the love you receive from your parents.

dialogue.origin: そうですかね？
dialogue.content: Do you think so?

dialogue.origin: ええ、ほんとうに。塾に行かせてもらえて当たり前と思っている方もたくさんいると思いますもの。
dialogue.content: Yes, I really do. I think there are many people who would take being able to attend cram school for granted, after all.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、、そうは思ってなかったです
dialogue.content: I see... I'd never thought of it that way.

dialogue.origin: 私は今までのお話を聞いて、あなたはほんとうに自分のことだけでなく周囲に気を配れる方なんだと感心しましたよ。ゆえに、苦しさが重なってしまうこともあるんだと感じました。
dialogue.content: Listening to you, I'm truly impressed by how considerate you are of others, not just yourself. But I also feel that this may be why your pain is compounded.

dialogue.origin: ご両親に受験のご報告したら、なんという言葉が返ってくると思いますか？
dialogue.content: When you tell your parents about the exam results, what do you think they'll say?

dialogue.origin: 悲しい顔はすると思いますが、頑張ったねって言ってくれると思います
dialogue.content: I think they’ll look sad, but they’ll also say, "You worked so hard."

dialogue.origin: ええ、ええ、そう思われるんですね。努力を近くで見守ってくれたご両親から頑張ったねと言われたらあなたのお気持ちはどうなりそうですか？
dialogue.content: Yes, I see. If your parents, who watched you work so hard up close, were to tell you, "You did your best," how do you think that would make you feel?

dialogue.origin: 落ちたけど今までやったことは無駄ではなかったかなって少しは思そうです
dialogue.content: Even though I failed, I think I might be able to feel, at least a little, that everything I've done up to now wasn't for nothing.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、ご両親の言葉で少し気持ちが落ち着くかもしれないですよね。
dialogue.content: That's right. Their words might help you feel a little calmer, mightn't they?

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そう言葉をかけられて、あなたはご両親になんとお伝えすると思いますか？
dialogue.content: After they say that to you, what do you think you'll say to your parents in return?

dialogue.origin: うーん
dialogue.content: Hmm...

dialogue.origin: まずはこれまで応援してくれたことに感謝ですかね
dialogue.content: First, I suppose I would thank them for all their support up to now.

dialogue.origin: ええ、まず感謝の言葉をお伝えするかな、とお考えなんですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're thinking you would start by expressing your gratitude.

dialogue.origin: はい、
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ただ、もしできそうであればあなたの苦しい気持ちや途方に暮れてしまうようなお気持ちもご両親に少しお話ししてもいいかもしれません
dialogue.content: However, if you feel up to it, it might also be good to share a little with your parents about how much you're hurting and how at a loss you feel.

dialogue.origin: はい、多分話しながら泣いちゃうと思うので、
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll probably end up crying as I'm talking to them...

dialogue.origin: うんうん...
dialogue.content: Mm-hm...

dialogue.origin: 気持ち理解してくれると思います
dialogue.content: I think they'll understand how I feel.

dialogue.origin: ええ、あなたのことを支えて見守ってくださる優しいご両親ですからきっとそうだと思います。
dialogue.content: Yes, since they are such kind parents who support and watch over you, I'm sure they will.

dialogue.origin: はい、そう思います、
dialogue.content: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.origin: この短い時間の中ですが、あなたがどれだけ努力されて頑張られてきたかそして今どれほどお辛い気持ちなのか考えると胸が苦しいです。でも
dialogue.content: Even in this short time we've had, it pains me to think about how hard you've strived and worked, and how much pain you must be in right now. But,

dialogue.origin: 努力が無駄ではなかったと思えるかもしれないと言ってくれただけで少し安心しました。
dialogue.content: I was a little relieved just to hear you say that you might be able to feel your efforts weren't for nothing.

dialogue.origin: 簡単に切り替えられるとは思いませんがここまでお話ししてみてお気持ちはいかがですか？
dialogue.content: I know it's not something you can just move on from easily, but how do you feel after having talked things through so far?

dialogue.origin: 少しスッキリしました、話したいことを話せた気がします
dialogue.content: I feel a little better. I feel like I was able to say everything I needed to.

dialogue.origin: そう思っていただけて嬉しく思います。
dialogue.content: I'm very glad you feel that way.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 優しく頼りになるご両親もあなたのこれまでの姿勢を見てきてくれているはずですのでここぞとばかりに甘えてみてもいいかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: Your kind and reliable parents have surely seen your dedication up to now, so perhaps this is a good chance to allow yourself to lean on them.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうですね、
dialogue.content: Yes, you're right.

dialogue.origin: よければまたお話にいらしてください。いつでもお待ちしています。
dialogue.content: If you'd like, please feel free to come and talk again. I'm always here for you.

dialogue.origin: はい、また来ます
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll come again.

dialogue.origin: 寒い日が続きますのでお体ご自愛下さい。ではそろそろお時間になりますので、失礼します。
dialogue.content: The cold weather is continuing, so please take care of yourself. Well, our time is just about up, so we'll stop here for today.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します。
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much. I appreciate your time.

dialogue.origin: ロープレありがとうございました。またよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for the role-play. I look forward to working with you again.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Likewise, I look forward to it as well.

topic.sub: 大学受験の失敗による進路不安
